page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance within the ecs.r7a family built on the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The host architecture comprises 32 physical cores configured with hyper-threading to provide 64 virtual central processing units. The system is provisioned with 512 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache specifications include 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 0.5 MB of L2 cache per core, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Networking relies on a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps without included public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not include local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmark results indicate strong multi-core compute capability and efficient cached memory access. The instance achieved top-quartile placements in stress-ng multi-core execution, PassMark CPU and encryption tests, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Clang software compilation. Inference testing with small language models (135M parameters) demonstrated strong prompt processing and text generation speeds. Conversely, uncached memory read bandwidth (76.39 GB/sec), uncached write bandwidth (35.1 GB/sec), and PassMark database operations fell into average ranges, while AVX-512 vector instructions are unsupported by the CPU implementation.

The 8 GB per vCPU memory allocation makes this instance qualitatively cost-effective for memory-heavy workloads that do not require local ephemeral storage. By delivering high RAM capacity alongside solid multi-threaded performance, it avoids the expense of accelerator-equipped hardware profiles while accommodating large datasets in memory. The absence of local disk drives requires reliance on network storage for persistent data, creating a potential I/O performance tradeoff for drive-bound systems. Suitable applications include in-memory analytical workloads, enterprise software compilation pipelines, middle-tier language model inference, and memory-intensive web or application servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by a 32-core AMD EPYC 7T83 processor providing 64 dedicated vCPUs at 2.55 GHz on a KVM hypervisor. Equipped with 512 GB of system memory, it delivers an 8 GB per vCPU density suited for memory-bound enterprise operations. Network bandwidth is rated at a baseline of 16 Gbps, and the configuration omits local disk storage and discrete GPUs. Benchmark results place the server in the top performance tier for multi-core processing, encryption, software compilation, and cached memory access, while uncached memory throughput and single-threaded file processing score within average parameters. The instance is structured for workloads prioritizing high system RAM allocation alongside strong multi-threaded execution, such as in-memory analytics, compilation platforms, and memory-centric application deployments.
